must_pass: toolchain evidence records one exact SUMO release, SUMO_HOME, package versions, source revision when available, and traci.__file__
a frozen minimal native headless scenario exits 0 and emits run_id plus scenario_hash
one sumo-gui diagnosis is documented without making GUI execution a batch dependency
TraCI and libsumo throughput, peak memory, and artifact bytes are measured on the same scenario and team hardware
Docker and WSL are not required for the native smoke-test command
gate_checks: all required artifacts exist and parse
run_manifest.run_id is non-empty and run_manifest.scenario_hash matches the frozen scenario bytes
throughput has comparable traci and libsumo measurements with units
gate.openDeltas is 0 and gate.decidedBy is tests-and-files
